subject: Mathlib v4.30.0-rc2 lake exe cache protocol map

layers.name: custom Mathlib cache key
layers.representation: UInt64 formatted as 16 hexadecimal digits plus .ltar
layers.role: names the local and remote per-module cache object

layers.name: transport object
layers.role: HTTP download/upload object; downloads land as .ltar.part then rename on success

layers.name: ltar internal Lake hash
layers.representation: 4-byte magic LTAR/LTR2/LTR3 followed by 8-byte little-endian UInt64
layers.role: Lake depHash used by Mathlib's skip-decompression check against the installed .trace

layers.name: module build payload
layers.representation: trace plus required/optional compiled artifacts and sidecar hashes
layers.role: files restored into Mathlib or dependency build directories by leantar

important_distinction: The .ltar filename hash is Mathlib's custom module-cache key. The hash in the .ltar header is a Lake dependency hash. They are different protocol layers and must not be treated as interchangeable.
